from(bucket: "qoo")

options.content:
QoO thresholds (gateway)
P50: ${qooLatencyP50Lower} - ${qooLatencyP50Upper} ms
P95: ${qooLatencyP95Lower} - ${qooLatencyP95Upper} ms
P99: ${qooLatencyP99Lower} - ${qooLatencyP99Upper} ms
Loss: ${qooLossLower} - ${qooLossUpper}
Min throughput: ${qooMinThroughputMbps} Mbps

targets.query:
sel = ${sources:json}
rollingWindow = duration(v: "${qooRollingWindow}")

passiveOn = contains(value: "passive", set: sel)
pingOn = contains(value: "active-ping", set: sel)
iperfOn = contains(value: "active-iperf3", set: sel)
godashOn = contains(value: "active-godash", set: sel)
webrtcOn = contains(value: "active-webrtc", set: sel)

componentScore = (measured, lower, upper) => {
  m = 1.0 - (measured - lower) / (upper - lower)
  clamped = if m < 0.0 then 0.0 else if m > 1.0 then 1.0 else m
  return clamped * 100.0
}

latencyBase = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "passive")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => passiveOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_ping_sample_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => pingOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_rtt_ms" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "false")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => godashOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_webrtc_receiver" and r._field == "rtt_ms")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => webrtcOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
])

mkLatency = (q, lower, upper, label) =>
  latencyBase
    |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
    |> quantile(q: q, method: "exact_selector")
    |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
    |> window(every: inf)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: componentScore(measured: r._value, lower: lower, upper: upper), label: label}))

latencyRows = union(tables: [
  mkLatency(q: 0.50, lower: float(v: ${qooLatencyP50Lower}), upper: float(v: ${qooLatencyP50Upper}), label: "Latency P50 QoO"),
  mkLatency(q: 0.95, lower: float(v: ${qooLatencyP95Lower}), upper: float(v: ${qooLatencyP95Upper}), label: "Latency P95 QoO"),
  mkLatency(q: 0.99, lower: float(v: ${qooLatencyP99Lower}), upper: float(v: ${qooLatencyP99Upper}), label: "Latency P99 QoO")
])

lossBase = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_loss_ratio" and r.mode == "passive")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => passiveOn)
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "flow"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.packets >= 0.0)
    |> rename(columns: {value: "_value"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_loss_ratio" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "true")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => pingOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_loss_ratio" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "false")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => godashOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_webrtc_receiver" and (r._field == "packets_lost" or r._field == "packets_received"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => webrtcOn)
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "session"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if (r.packets_lost + r.packets_received) > 0.0 then r.packets_lost / (r.packets_lost + r.packets_received) else 0.0}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
    |> movingAverage(n: 10)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
])

lossRow = lossBase
  |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
  |> mean()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: componentScore(measured: r._value, lower: float(v: ${qooLossLower}), upper: float(v: ${qooLossUpper})), label: "Loss QoO"}))

throughputBase = union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_throughput_mbps" and r.mode == "passive")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => passiveOn)
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "flow"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.value >= 0.0 and r.packets >= 0.0)
    |> rename(columns: {value: "_value"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_throughput_mbps" and r._field == "value" and r.mode == "active" and r.bandwidth == "true")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => iperfOn)
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]),
  from(bucket: "qoo")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "qoo_webrtc_receiver" and r._field == "bytes_received")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => webrtcOn)
    |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 8.0 / 1000000.0}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
])

throughputRow = throughputBase
  |> window(every: 5s, period: rollingWindow)
  |> min()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r._value >= float(v: ${qooMinThroughputMbps}) then 100.0 else 0.0, label: "Throughput QoO"}))

componentRows = union(tables: [latencyRows, lossRow, throughputRow])

overallRow = componentRows
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> min(column: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, label: "Overall QoO"}))

overallRow

  |> group()

  |> last()
